video.caption: The first 3.2 s of the flush, slowed down 2.5 times, front half of the bowl removed; colour shows the water speed. OpenFOAM CFD, medium mesh (2 mm cells at the wall). After 1.3 s the trap outlet in this run draws air, so the bowl holds more water than in the fast model.
